Raster is 2000x2714. mode="true" in manifest.json (confirmed) → J6 na per policy. No occluders declared in manifest/scene, and SVG has empty <g data-stage="5-occluders"> and <g data-stage="7-sight-rays"> → J4 na. No fan elements in SVG, none drawn → J9 na. No `labels:` block in the .scene → J3 na.

J1 pass: pixel-sampled colours match D9 exactly — bad/mistake line = (179,46,46) = #b32e2e (failing), good/ideal line = (176,125,30) = #b07d1e (caution); confirmed again in SVG stroke/marker-fill attributes.

J7 pass: nothing rendered beyond the 2 declared lines + road + legend; no invented occluders/rays/fan.

J8 pass: legend text ("premature@all — mistake · failing (runoff)" / "chained 32 km/h — ideal · caution (contained)") crisp black-on-cream at top-left (0–600,0–80); road grey, cream background, white dashed centreline, gold and red lines all clearly separable at native res.

J2 FAIL: the mistake ("bad") line carries zero marker glyphs. SVG's <g data-stage="9-markers"> contains 4 turn_point hourglasses + 5 apex rings + 4 exit dots + 4 release chevrons, ALL with data-line-id="good" — none with data-line-id="bad", despite "premature" being defined by an early turn_in event on that very line (the marker-from-event law requires an hourglass wherever a turn_in event exists). Visually corroborated: near original-px (1783,175) the only bowtie/hourglass shape present is gold; the red polyline merely passes close by with no glyph of its own anywhere along its length (checked full extent y=222–1106, x=890–1788 via colour-mask scan).

J5 FAIL: the note claims "Each corner wider than the last — an early turn-in compounds through the sequence" and the scene comment claims per-corner peak lean "strictly increases across the chain," but the rendered mistake line diverges through only the FIRST corner and then terminates. Colour-mask over the full raster shows every red pixel confined to y∈[222,1106] of 2714 (top 41% of the frame) — nothing below y=1106 even though the good line's markers continue on to y≈2650 across 3 more corners. SVG confirms: the "bad" polyline's last vertex is (33.72,15.82) with its off_road arrowhead+tick immediately after (a correctly-placed edge-crossing terminal, visible as a small red arrow at original-px ≈(900,1085), on-pavement at the verge — the standing_sentence's termination requirement IS satisfied structurally), but that station sits before the good line's own second turn-in (cy≈22.6) — i.e. the mistake runs off within/just after corner 1, never reaching corners 2–4. A reader sees one small excursion, not compounding "each corner wider than the last," and does not see runoff at the final corner as the design's F-ORACLE-CHAIN pin and the figure's own caption both promise.

Note: manifest's own gate_verdict for fig-08-06 is "fail," consistent with (though not the primary basis for) the above.

Manifest confirms mode="true" (J6 na, no fan → J9 na) and declares no occluders anywhere in the schema (J4 na). Scene/manifest declare no callout "labels" set (only a legend) → J3 na, nothing to check.

J1 pass: pixel-sampled line colours exactly match the D9 mapping — red line = RGB(179,46,46) = #b32e2e (failing, "bad") at (907,1082); gold line = RGB(176,125,30) = #b07d1e (caution, "good") at (130,2593). J5 pass: the mistake (red) line cuts a visibly straighter, more direct diagonal into the first corner versus gold's wider road-hugging arc, diverging exactly at the shared turn-in hourglass (1793,232); the divergence widens through the bend and the red line runs off the pavement, terminating in an off-road glyph at (907,1082) sitting right on the outer road-edge boundary (grey→green transition). This reads immediately as "turned in too early → ran out of road."

J7 pass, standing sentence holds: the failing line's endpoint (907,1082) sits exactly at the road-edge crossing — arrowhead pointing off-pavement plus a short tick along the edge, matching the design's off_road terminal-glyph spec for outcome=runoff — not wandering into the grass, not exiting the frame uncropped. Good line's endpoint is a plain arrowhead at (131,2596), matching outcome=contained (no off-road tick). No sight rays, no occlusion shading, no extra glyphs beyond the four declared marker classes and the two declared lines were found anywhere in the tiled review. Both lines are flush-cut at the top frame edge coincident with view.window.from_s=0 (clamped to road start per the window formula), so this is the road's actual origin, not a silently-clipped mid-trajectory approach — no missing entry-annotation violation.

J8 pass: at native 2x raster the ~5-7px strokes are cleanly separated and hue-distinguishable everywhere the two lines diverge (red/gold never ambiguous); where the two paths are literally coincident (the top straight, by design ideal-line z-order) only gold shows, which is the documented z-order, not a legibility defect. Legend text zoomed 2x is crisp, no artifacting, fully readable ("premature@all — mistake · failing (runoff)" / "chained 32 km/h — ideal · caution (contained)").
